# nexla-cli

> Command-line client for the Nexla agent API — create and operate sources,
> sinks, nexsets, credentials, flows, connectors, toolsets, and flow/log
> triage. Built for non-interactive use by agents: `-o json`/`-o ndjson`
> output, a stable numeric exit-code taxonomy, `--dry-run` on every mutation,
> `--page-all` for complete lists, and a live `schema` command. Depends only
> on `typer` and `httpx`.

## Operating the CLI

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): repo-root operating guide — non-interactive
  invocation, the JSON/NDJSON + stderr-error contract, the 7 exit codes,
  `--dry-run`/`--page-all` safety, discovery, and auth env vars.
- [src/nexla_cli/AGENTS.md](src/nexla_cli/AGENTS.md): CLI invariants an agent
  can't infer from `--help` — output modes, `--json`/`--params` precedence,
  `--wait-until`, DB-sink table preflight, probe param shapes, standalone-OAuth
  limitation.

## Install & usage

- [README.md](README.md): install (PyPI/uv, npm, source), quick start, global
  flags, raw JSON payloads, response sanitization, and the full command
  reference table.
- `nexla-cli --help` / `nexla-cli <group> --help`: live command surface.
- `nexla-cli schema [<resource>.<verb>]`: machine-readable OpenAPI subset for
  one command or the whole `/nexla/*` API surface.

## Skill pack

- [Using this CLI from Claude Code](README.md#using-this-cli-from-claude-code):
  `nexla-cli skill install` ships `SKILL.md` + `AGENTS.md` + the vendored Nexla
  domain reference (`skill_pack/`) into an agent's skills directory.
